answer: Sybil defense rests on a per-identity slashing bond, not a wallet check. Each new seat needs its own bond plus two attestations from seated members, who stake balance behind the newcomer. A clone farm must supply real people and capital per fake seat, since honest rewards are priced below bond plus attestation cost. If a clone double-answers, slashing burns that bond and part of its attestors' stakes, so one detection cascades across the cluster. Rotating words like ridge, tide and summit reset each epoch, so copied answers score zero.
